quests.title: Master's study session (1 h)
quests.description: One focused hour of readings, notes, or coursework for the Master's program.
quests.flavor: Candlelight flickers over the scholar's desk as new mastery takes root.

chains.title: Road to Santiago
chains.description: Step-by-step preparation for walking the Camino de Santiago pilgrimage.

steps.title: 5 km walk
steps.description: Head out for an easy, continuous 5 km walk.
steps.flavor: The yellow shell points the way forward.

steps.title: 10 km walk
steps.description: Extend your range with a steady 10 km walk.
steps.flavor: Your stride settles into a pilgrim's cadence.

steps.title: Buy proper walking boots
steps.description: Get fitted for trail-ready walking boots and merino socks.
steps.flavor: You equip Pilgrim Boots (+2 Trail Resilience).

steps.title: 15 km with backpack
steps.description: Walk 15 km carrying your loaded Camino pack.
steps.flavor: Shoulders and hips learn the balance of the pack.

steps.title: Break in boots on 3 walks
steps.description: Complete three training walks in your new boots until they feel like home.
steps.flavor: Not a single blister can slow you down now.

steps.title: 20 km walk
steps.description: Complete a full 20 km stage walk in a single day.
steps.flavor: Distance becomes a meditation in motion.

steps.title: Two consecutive 15 km days
steps.description: Walk 15 km on two back-to-back days to test trail recovery.
steps.flavor: Waking up on day two and lacing your boots is the true test.

steps.title: Plan Camino stages
steps.description: Map out your daily stages, towns, and rest stops along the route.
steps.flavor: Waymarks and ancient villages line your parchment map.

steps.title: Book first albergue
steps.description: Reserve your first night's albergue at the starting point.
steps.flavor: A warm bunk awaits at the trailhead.

steps.title: Buen Camino!
steps.description: Step onto the trail and begin the pilgrimage.
steps.flavor: Ultreia et Suseia! Beyond and higher—Buen Camino!

chains.title: Get Promoted
chains.description: Personalized career growth questline to step into the next role with clarity and confidence.

steps.title: Define what the next level looks like for you
steps.description: Write down the exact scope, title, and impact you want in your next role.
steps.flavor: Clarity is the compass of ambition.

steps.title: List your key wins from the last 6 months
steps.description: Build a brag document of outcomes, leadership moments, and solved problems.
steps.flavor: Your chronicle of deeds speaks for itself.

steps.title: Align with your manager on promotion criteria
steps.description: Share your goal and ask what concrete evidence is needed for the next level.
steps.flavor: The guild requirements are now out in the open.

steps.title: Lead one high-visibility initiative
steps.description: Take ownership of a project that showcases next-level impact.
steps.flavor: You step forward to lead the vanguard.

steps.title: Gather feedback after 1 month
steps.description: Check in with your manager and peers to confirm you are on track.
steps.flavor: Allies add their commendations to your dossier.

steps.title: Have the promotion conversation
steps.description: Present your impact calm and proud, and ask for the promotion.
